result.note: Tested the structural outcome of the April 2026 Kerala Assembly election and the alliance alignment of the IUML.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, the Indian National Congress named V.D. Satheesan as Chief Minister of Kerala. Consider the following statements about the April 2026 Kerala Assembly elections and their outcome:
items: The Congress-led United Democratic Front won 102 of the 140 Assembly seats.
The result ended a decade of Left Democratic Front rule under Pinarayi Vijayan.
The Indian Union Muslim League, which backed Satheesan, is a constituent of the Left Democratic Front.
questions.ask: How many of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The third statement is wrong because the story describes the IUML as the UDF's most influential alliance partner, not an LDF constituent. Satheesan, a six-time legislator from Paravur and Leader of the Opposition since 2021, was chosen over K.C. Venugopal and Ramesh Chennithala.
questions.source: ending 11 days of internal jockeying after the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) swept the April assembly elections with 102 of 140 seats
